$comment: Frozen vectors for src/crypto/DeviceIdentity.js. Not an output to refresh — if a change makes these fail, the question is whether the wire format version should move, not whether this file should be regenerated. Nothing here has the shape of a secret, deliberately: the keypair is derived in the test from a seed of 32 0x2a bytes, the public key is pinned through its fingerprint, and each signature is pinned through its SHA-256. Ed25519 is deterministic, so a hash pins a signature exactly as tightly as the signature would, without committing 88 characters of high-entropy base64 that no scanner can tell from a leaked key. See test/device-identity-vectors.test.js.
